title: Value on the negative first coordinate
statement: For every $q\in\mathbb{N}$ and every sign vector $x$ in the cube of dimension equal to the tail dimension associated with $q$, the real-valued version of the constructed Boolean function, evaluated at the vector whose first coordinate is $-1$ and whose remaining coordinates are $x$, equals $2$ times the indicator of the associated small set at $x$ minus $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of the associated tail dimension
